a.xlink:title: Sales proposal — forecast. on_p tracks weighted probability. Model: apps/transactions/models/proposal.py Functions: transfer_proposal_to_order @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:219 (converts proposal to order) Pending deltas: on_p: +qty_x_prob
Forecast quantity from proposals — weighted by probability. Functions: Item.quantity['on_p'] @ apps/products/models/item.py:238 (forecast from proposals)

Sales order — customer commitment. Creates +on_so and -on_p pending records. Model: apps/transactions/models/order.py Functions: transfer_proposal_to_order @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:219 (creates order from proposal) _create_transfer_pending_records @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_order.py:131 (pending records for +on_so, -on_p) Pending deltas: on_so: +qty, on_p: -qty
Committed to sales orders — reduces available. Functions: Item.quantity['on_so'] @ apps/products/models/item.py:238 (committed to sales orders)

Invoice — shipment event. Financial event triggers GL and inventory movement. Model: apps/transactions/models/invoice.py Functions: transfer_order_to_invoice @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_invoice.py:16 (creates invoice from order) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_invoice.py:332 (-on_hand, -on_so, +on_in) Pending deltas: on_hand: -qty, on_so: -qty, on_in: +qty GL: AR debit, Revenue credit, Tax credit, COGS debit, Inventory credit, Commission
Invoiced — goods that have been shipped. Functions: Item.quantity['on_in'] @ apps/products/models/item.py:238 (invoiced/shipped)

Purchase order to vendor. GAP: +on_po pending record is NOT created. Model: apps/transactions/models/purchase.py Functions: transfer_order_to_purchase @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_purchase.py:14 (creates PO from order) transfer_proposal_to_purchase @ apps/transactions/services/proposal_to_purchase.py:13 (creates PO from proposal) Pending deltas: on_po: +qty (GAP: not implemented — no Pending.objects.create)
Expected from purchase orders — increases available. Functions: Item.quantity['on_po'] @ apps/products/models/item.py:238 (expected from purchase orders)

Receipt of purchased goods. Creates pending for +on_hand, -on_po. Model: apps/transactions/models/receipt.py Functions: receive_purchase @ apps/transactions/services/flow.py:219 (receipt processing) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/flow.py:308 (+on_hand, -on_po) Pending deltas: on_hand: +qty, on_po: -qty
Physical inventory — what is in the warehouse. Functions: Item.quantity['on_hand'] @ apps/products/models/item.py:238 (physical inventory count)

Work order completion — production items enter inventory. Model: apps/transactions/models/workorder.py Functions: complete_workorder @ apps/transactions/services/flow.py:361 (WO completion) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/flow.py:452 (+on_hand, -on_wo) Pending deltas: on_hand: +qty, on_wo: -qty
In production via work orders — increases available. Functions: Item.quantity['on_wo'] @ apps/products/models/item.py:238 (in production)
Work order completion event. Same service as workorder. Functions: complete_workorder @ apps/transactions/services/flow.py:361 (WO completion processing) Pending deltas: on_hand: +qty, on_wo: -qty
Computed available quantity: on_hand - allocated. Recomputed on save. Functions: Item.save @ apps/products/models/item.py:493 (available = on_hand - allocated)
Reserved inventory — committed to sales orders. Subtracted from on_hand to get available. Functions: Item.quantity['allocated'] @ apps/products/models/item.py:269 (reserved for committed orders)
Returns pending — goods expected back from customers. Functions: Item.quantity['on_r'] @ apps/products/models/item.py:238 (returns pending)
